name: Pawa Poke Dash
source:
Main character is a first grader on an elementary school. He watches baseball game with his father when ball hits father rendering him unconscious. Baseball hermit appears before protagonist and promises to save father from death is hero wins baseball tournament within five years.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是小学一年级学生。他和父亲观看棒球比赛时，父亲被飞来的球击中，陷入昏迷。棒球隐士出现在主人公面前，承诺只要英雄能在五年内赢得棒球锦标赛，就会把父亲从死亡边缘救回来。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndreview[/url]]
